description:
We are looking for Web Developer in Las Vegas, NV for 5+ months contract position. 
  
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects.
  
 Below are the Job Details for the Position
 Title: Web Developer 
 Location: Las Vegas, NV
 Duration: 5+ months
 Client: Direct Client
 

 Job Description: 
 

 

 


 Mandatory:
 

 

 

 2-5 years HTML/CSS/Javascript development experience
 

 2-5 years professional Java development experience
 

 A bachelors degree in CS or equivalent
 

 Passionate about writing easy to read, minimal, effective Java code
 

 Flexibility and great problem solving skills
 

 Well developed sense of humor
 

 

 

 Desired:
 

 

 

 Experience working with Adobe AEM or other Content Management System
 

 Understanding of server environments
 

 Passion for getting the development process running efficiently, with an understanding of different development methodologies
 

 Motivated to inspire grown-ups to play!

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
